segments.label: Historical heading
segments.original:
CAP. LXXII.
PROROGA
Della sospensione de’ Tribunali.
segments.english:
Chapter 72
Extension
Of the suspension of the tribunals.

segments.label: Extension of suspension
segments.original: Per euitare il pericolo, che dall’vnione di gente potesse sortire, furono sino sotto li 25. del mese passato sospesi gli essercitij de i Tribunali, e con il presente Editto se ne indica la Proroga ad arbitrio della Congregatione della Sanità.
segments.english: To avoid the danger that might result from people gathering, the tribunals’ activities were suspended as early as the 25th of last month; this edict announces an extension at the discretion of the Congregation of Health.

segments.label: Enforcement and privileged urgent matters
segments.original: Si eccettuano però li oblighi Camerali, e materie esecutiue, etiam per Contradictas, & Edictum, Attentati, Alimenti, Pigioni di casa, Pensioni, & altri decreti meri prouisionali, e di materie priuilegiate.
segments.english: Exceptions are made for obligations enforceable through the Camera and enforcement matters, including those per Contradictas and Edictum; Attentati (a historical procedural category); maintenance, house rents and pensions; and other purely provisional decrees and privileged matters.

segments.label: Orders and instruments already decreed
segments.original: Li Mandati, e speditioni decretate auanti l’Editto, con la essecutione de’ mandati da decretarsi.
segments.english: Orders and the issuing of instruments decreed before the edict, together with execution of orders yet to be decreed.

segments.label: Appeals and stays
segments.english: Appeals together with prohibitory or stay orders.

segments.label: Monitory notices and related instruments
segments.original: Monitorij, & altre speditioni, etiam consecutiuè, per la causa de partibus.
segments.english: Monitory notices and other instruments, including subsequent ones, for the causa de partibus.

segments.label: Risk of flight and security for proceedings
segments.original: Li sospetti di fuga, e prouisioni pro assecuratione Iudicij.
segments.english: Matters involving suspected flight and measures to secure the judicial proceedings (pro assecuratione Iudicij).

segments.label: Rota and Camera cases; avoiding crowds
segments.original: Quanto alle Cause di Rota, e di Camera possa procedersi non solo nelle Cause sudette, ma anche in tutte le altre, le quali sono state disputate, e presone le risolutioni, e possano anco spedirsi quelle per sentenze, benchè li termini siano caduti, e seruati dentro li quindici giorni della sospensione precedente. Rimettendo alla prudenza de’ Giudici il modo di tenere la loro audienza senza tumulto, e concorso di persone per li rispetti accennati.
segments.english: For cases before the Rota and the Camera, proceedings may continue not only in the aforesaid matters but also in all other cases that have been argued and on which resolutions have been taken. Those cases may also be disposed of by judgments, even though the procedural periods fell and were observed within the fifteen days of the preceding suspension. The manner of holding hearings without disorder or crowds, for the reasons already stated, is left to the judges’ prudence.

notes.text: The Latin procedural labels “per Contradictas”, “Edictum”, “causa de partibus”, and “pro assecuratione Iudicij” are retained where a confident modern equivalent would require specialist legal-historical analysis. “Attentati” is retained as a procedural category rather than assigned a modern criminal-law meaning.

The final clause on procedural periods (“li termini siano caduti, e seruati”) is rendered closely and should be checked by a legal historian before drawing conclusions about deadline computation. The order retains a list of exceptions and is not a complete closure of all judicial business.
The image reads 25 of the preceding month in the opening; OCR gives 15. The dateline is 9 July 1656. The references are preserved as printed rather than harmonized with another document’s date.
